# Homework #5

## Get Data

```{r}
install.packages("palmerpenguins")
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- palmerpenguins::penguins
head(penguins)
```

## Calculate Summary Statistics

```{r}

numeric_means <- apply(penguins[ ,c(3,4,5,6)],2,mean,na.rm = TRUE)
print(numeric_means)
```

## Count Penguins by Species

```{r}
species_counts <- tapply(penguins,penguins$species,count)
print(species_counts)
```

## Analyze Bill Length by Species

```{r}
bill_length_means <- lapply(split(penguins$bill_length_mm,penguins$species),mean,na.rm = TRUE)
print(bill_length_means)
```

## Create a Summary Table

```{r}
summary_table <- sapply(penguins[ ,c(3,4,5,6)],function(x) c(mean = mean(x,na.rm = TRUE),sd = sd(x,na.rm = TRUE)))
print(summary_table)
```
